composition_variation: Create a mature editorial anime portrait of Tsunade in a peaceful terrace garden. Preserve her long blonde twin sections of hair, amber-brown eyes, and small forehead diamond. Dress her in a fully covering cream high-neck blouse, green open jacket, relaxed dark trousers, and flat shoes. She stands with an easy side lean against a solid balcony rail, holding a small ceramic tea cup. Use olive foliage, pale limestone, honey morning light, and a quiet washed-green background. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
